fusions.name: Damp Rot
fusions.desc: Your weapon carries damp spores for one strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mildew Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud of wet spores around you that deals 26 damage, plus 4% of the maximum health of a boss or elite, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Damp Bed
fusions.desc: Spreads a bed of wet moss where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Creeping Damp
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
